ownerDirective.speaker: Governor
ownerDirective.exactText: i'm the governmor of the minecraft world and I've come to cut red tape
ownerDirective.interpretation: The finite mid-shaft Ravensreach recovery crossover is delegated to the implementation team; hard safety is not waived.

mvpBoundary.included: Only the exact dry mid-shaft crossover, shell, and retained ladder interfaces.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: No public route, passenger boarding/service, vehicle, power, signal, or water-sleeve alteration is authorized.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Exact state/inverse, retained ladder proofs, water-band exclusion, and independent QA are mandatory.
Fresh immutable source and exact preflight immediately precede mutation.
Forward and reverse parser validation is strict-noop.
Exact block-entity and fresh live-entity clearance are mandatory.
Execution is journaled; failure invokes exact reverse rollback.
Fresh post capture, rollback poststate proof, and independent QA precede acceptance.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: Failure blocks only this exact mid-shaft recovery crossover.
